title: Career Roadmap · HVAC Technician
summary: An HVAC Technician installs, services and repairs heating, ventilation, air-conditioning and refrigeration systems in homes, commercial buildings, factories and other facilities.

facts.Current degree: ITI Trades – Refrigeration & AC / Electronics / Mobile Phone

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 with Science and Mathematics for the DGT Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Technician trade.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science in Classes 11–12 is useful, but not required for every technical route.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Cooling systems, electrical circuits, ventilation, refrigeration and building maintenance.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Basic electrical safety, hand tools, measurement and troubleshooting.

blocks.text: The DGT lists Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Technician as a two-year CTS trade, with Class 10 Science and Mathematics (or an accepted equivalent vocational subject) as its stated entry qualification. Verify current official notification.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Electrical safety, tools, refrigeration cycle, temperature and pressure measurement.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Core skills
blocks.text: AC installation, servicing, cleaning, leak checks and routine maintenance.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Compressor diagnosis, electrical controls, refrigerant handling and commercial HVAC systems.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Supervised service calls, maintenance reports, practical assessments and apprenticeship applications.

blocks.text: ITI Electrician / Electronics Mechanic → HVAC controls and electrical troubleshooting.

blocks.text: Relevant diploma → HVAC design support, site supervision or maintenance planning, subject to job requirements.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Residential and commercial buildings, hospitals, hotels, retail, data centres, cold chains, manufacturing and facilities management.

blocks.label: Technical skills
blocks.text: Electrical troubleshooting, refrigeration cycle, pressure and temperature measurement, leak detection, maintenance documentation and customer communication.

blocks.label: Tools / technologies
blocks.text: Manifold gauge, vacuum pump, multimeter, clamp meter, leak detector and temperature instruments.
Useful credentials

items.text: DGT / NCVT-recognized relevant trade certificate.
Apprenticeship completion credential, where awarded.
Manufacturer-specific HVAC training.
Refrigerant-handling and electrical-safety training appropriate to the job and destination country.
